scope: exact body-4 tagged trace fold only

guard_targets.Body4PartitionGuardTarget: prefix rows 1-3 and suffix rows 5-6 have body != 3; bodyTraceRows4 has body = 3
guard_targets.Body4RowColFrequencyGuardTarget: each bodyTraceRows4 row has body/row/col guard, frequency [0,nu2,nu3,0,0,0], and nonzero rational denominators
guard_targets.Body4PhaseReductionTarget: guarded frequency reduces tracePhase to nu2*q1 + nu3*q2
guard_targets.Body4EntryGuardReductionTarget: inside bodyTraceRows4, body guard reduces traceRowContribution to row/col guard
guard_targets.Body4OffBlockGuardReductionTarget: outside body-4 block, body guard makes traceRowContribution zero

conjugate_targets.ConjugateTaggedPairTarget: same body/row/col; frequency negation; equal real tag lift; opposite imaginary tag lift; nonzero denominators
conjugate_targets.ConjugateAtomPairTarget: ConjugateTaggedPairTarget plus exact-real traceAtom equality for every q
conjugate_targets.Body4ConjugatePairWitnessTarget: both rows are members of bodyTraceRows4 and satisfy the pair target
conjugate_targets.Body4ConjugatePairCoverageTarget: each body-4 row has a source-supplied partner; coverage alone does not assert disjointness

fold_targets.Body4FullToBlockFoldTarget: bodyTraceEvaluator 3 q i j = body4BlockFold q i j
fold_targets.Body4BlockFoldTarget: body_4_piecewise q i j = body4BlockFold q i j
fold_targets.Body4TraceFoldHandoffTarget: body_4_piecewise q i j = bodyTraceEvaluator 3 q i j

dependencies.body_geometry: not modified and not used as a proof premise here

static_checks.scope: target symbol/path/hash and forbidden-token check only
